ValidationRule.description: VR-OPP-12: Booking Bucket must be set at Negotiate stage. Drives Net Bookings calculation and quota reporting.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4-Negotiate'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5-Won') ), NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)), ISPICKVAL(Booking_Bucket__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Booking Bucket is required from Negotiate stage onwards. Classify this deal before advancing.
